To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
four rat monoclonal antibodies were developed that specifically recognize and bind the MOPC 167 anti-phosphcholine (PC) transgene encoded immunoglobulin of 207- 4 transgenic mice.
we have developed anti-Id Mab that bind to the transgenic-encoded MOPC167 sIgM and inhibit its binding to PC, and that they are useful in the analysis of PC-transgenic B cell populations.
four rat x mouse hybridoma cell lines secreting MAb that bind to the transgenically encoded MOPC167 PC-specific IgA antibody have been developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and characterization of a panel of monoclonal antibodies which recognize the MOPC 167 anti-phosphorylcholine idiotype.
the development of transgenic mice which produce antibodies with defined specificity.
the development of a transgenic mouse model that expresses a myeloma protein, the IgA, PC-specific MOPC 167.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the anti-idiotypes described here are specific for the MHC class II-restricted transgene-encoded MOPC167 IgA antibody and that they are useful in studying the activation of transgenic B cells.
these anti-Id antibodies are useful for the analysis of B-cell development in the 207-PC transgenic mice.
these anti-Id MOPC167 antibodies are specific for the transgenic VH and kappa 24 gene products and are useful in the study of the 207 and 216 transgenic mouse lines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
these anti-idiotypics were generated by immunizing rats with MOPC 167, and that they can inhibit the binding of 207- 4 cells to PC.
the 28-6.20 MAb is a very useful reagent for the identification of PC transgenic B cells in 207-4 and 216-7 mice.
the anti-Id MOPC167 Mab can be used to study the development of the transgene encoded MOPC167 B cells in the transgenic mice and that the MOPC 167 Mab can induce B cell proliferation in vitro.
The main takeaway from our work is that
anti-idiotypc antibodies can induce DNA synthesis in transgenic B cells.
anti-idiotypics are a useful tool for studying the activation of idiotope-positive cells.
the anti-Id Mabs can be used to identify the B cell population in transgenic mice that express the MOPC 167 transgene.
